Date: Tue, 29 Sep 2026 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Quick follow-up: office hours — joined briefly, failed auth

Hi Alex,

Saw that you joined our scheduled office hours a few minutes ago but left shortly after — wanted to check in and make it easy to reconnect. If you ran into an auth error (401) or a firewall/proxy block, we can either:

- Do a short, focused troubleshooting call to swap a working token and walk the SDK setup (15–20m), or
- Share a prebuilt local container and a checklist you can run without hitting your corporate egress, then meet for a quick pass to confirm integration.

If you have a preferred option, reply with times that work or I can propose a couple. I've copied Ben (solutions engineer) and Rafael (renewal lead) in case we need to surface alternate capacity.

Thanks —
Monica Patel
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: redwood-debug-checklist.pdf (PDF, 120 KB)]

From: Alex Turner <alex.turner@atlashealth.com>

Subject: Re: Quick follow-up: office hours — joined briefly, failed auth

Hi Monica — thanks for the follow-up. I did join but our engineering team saw repeated 401s when we tried the sample call; the UI session showed the token exchange page but it timed out. We're behind a corporate proxy that blocks unknown outbound endpoints, so I couldn't pull the SDK examples either.

I can do the container route if that avoids egress, or we can try a short call where you provide a temporary token and we mirror the request from inside our network.

Available today after 4pm PT or tomorrow morning before 11am PT.

— Alex Turner
Senior Engineer, Integrations | Atlas Health

Thanks for the context. Short plan:

1) I'll generate a one-hour scoped API token (temp-api-token.txt) that only permits a single /v1/hello call — safe to test from inside their network.
2) I'll attach a tiny Docker image reference and a trimmed troubleshooting checklist so they can run locally without reaching out to our public endpoints (docker://redwood/local-run:latest).
3) If the token call succeeds, we can do a 15m screenshare to finalize SDK config.

Alex — attaching the checklist and the token stub. If you prefer, we can also give a short curl that uses the token so your infra team can try it from within the proxy.
